meaning.en: A lack of balance, as in distribution or functioning.

meaning.en: Lack of balance, as in proportion, force, functioning, etc.
meaning.vi: Thiếu sự cân bằng, như tỷ lệ, lực lượng, chức năng, v.v.

meaning.en: The property of not being in balance.

meaning_vi: sự không cân bằng; sự thiếu cân bằng

sentences.en: In this paper we show how the business cycle creates disequilibrium and imbalances in the economy.

sentences.en: That means no big tax give-aways, which would only stoke consumer demand and worsen the economic imbalances presently being experienced.
